recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any cleanup of the separate DocumentReference folder value set with URL http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/valueset-doc-typecodes should be handled as a separate terminology/publication decision, not as part of FHIR-28078.
issue_request: FHIR-28078 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request asking that DocumentReference.type stop using the old C80 document type value set and instead use the same document type value set as Composition.type.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-28078 was found. The apparent pre-application is commit cebeac615e0c434ff755a1aa763781d2cf61c8c2, which changed DocumentReference.type from bindingName DocumentC80Type and ValueSet/c80-doc-typecodes to bindingName DocumentType and ValueSet/doc-typecodes.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists composition and documentreference as active resources. Current Composition.type and DocumentReference.type both have preferred bindings to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/doc-typecodes, and the Composition value set source describes all LOINC codes where SCALE_TYP is DOC. OO minutes on 2025-09-08 record the issue as marked pre-applied and approved pre-applied 6-0-0.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already implements the requested binding alignment and no source edit is needed.
